Here is a comparative breakdown of your current skills and experience against our skills database, along with recommended courses to take your career to the next level.

---

### **1. Skills You Already Have**

Based on your 1-year experience as a Graphic Artist with Amazon and your design background, you already possess high-demand competencies that match the following database standards:

* **Figma & UI/UX Prototyping:** Directly aligns with digital product design and interface creation roles.
* **Adobe Photoshop & Visual Asset Creation:** Directly matches our benchmark for **Adobe Graphic Designer** and visual design.
* **Website Design:** Establishes a strong foundation in user interfaces and web layouts.
* **Corporate Production Experience:** Your background with Amazon demonstrates proven ability to handle creative briefs, turnaround times, and brand standards.

---

### **2. Recommended Courses to Take Next**

Depending on your direction—whether advancing into higher-paying digital design tracks or broadening into general shift and workplace operations—here are the top matched courses:

#### **Track A: Deepening Your UI/UX & Graphic Design Expertise**
* **[UI/UX Designer Professional Certificate](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/ibm-ui-ux-designer)**  
  * **Skill Area:** UI Design  
  * **Why take it:** Validates your website design background with formal credentials in user experience workflows and design systems.
* **[Figma UI/UX Masterclass](https://www.udemy.com/courses/search/?src=ukw&q=Figma%20UI%2FUX%20Masterclass)**  
  * **Skill Area:** Figma  
  * **Why take it:** Sharpens your existing Figma capabilities into advanced prototyping, auto-layouts, and component libraries.
* **[Design that Demands Attention Professional Certificate](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/adobe-graphic-designer)**  
  * **Skill Area:** Adobe Graphic Designer  
  * **Why take it:** Builds official certification on top of your Adobe Photoshop experience to showcase on your resume.
* **[Graphic Design Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/graphic-design)**  
  * **Skill Area:** Graphic and Visual Design  
  * **Why take it:** Covers core design theory, typography, and composition to strengthen your overall creative portfolio.

---

#### **Track B: Essential Workplace & Service Skills (For General Shift Roles)**
* **[English for Effective Business Communication](https://www.coursera.org/learn/english-for-working-together-in-business)**  
  * **Skill Area:** Communication  
  * **Why take it:** Enhances verbal and written interaction with team members, supervisors, and customers across shift environments.
* **[Customer Experience Management](https://www.coursera.org/learn/customer-experience-management)**  
  * **Skill Area:** Customer Relationship Management  
  * **Why take it:** Prepares you for customer-facing store and service roles if you take on shifts in retail, dining, or operations.

---

### **Coach's Tip:**
Having 1 year of design experience at Amazon at age 17 is a huge competitive edge. While General Shift Help is great for immediate income, completing the **[UI/UX Designer Professional Certificate](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/ibm-ui-ux-designer)** will quickly position you for remote, hybrid, and higher-earning creative roles well above your minimum target pay.

Hello Aiden! It is great to see your passion for creative work. With your 1-year background as a graphic artist at Amazon and your experience in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, and website design, you already have a fantastic creative foundation.

### Current Job Database Reality
In our current active jobs database, there are **no direct digital art or graphic design studio roles** listed at this moment (the current openings primarily focus on service, logistics, and retail shift help). 

However, if you want roles where your keen eye for design, color harmony, visual presentation, and brand awareness are highly valued, here are the most relevant positions from our database:

1. **[Merchandiser](https://careers.unilever.com/en/philippines)**

2. **[Sales Associate](https://www.fastretailing.com/employment/en/)**  
   * **Company:** UNIQLO Philippines  
   * **Adjacent Job:** Retail Assistant  
   * **Why it fits:** Uniqlo places strong emphasis on strict visual standards, aesthetic store layouts, and display presentation.

3. **[Promodiser](https://www.suyen.com.ph)**  
   * **Company:** Bench  
   * **Adjacent Job:** Retail Sales Associate  
   * **Why it fits:** Bench is a fashion and lifestyle brand where creative presentation, styling, and visual brand representation play a central role.

---

### Upskilling: Elevating Your Art & Design Career
To help you qualify for advanced design and digital art positions as new openings appear, you can strengthen your portfolio and technical credentials with these recommended courses:

* **Graphic Design & Visual Identity:**  
  * [Design that Demands Attention Professional Certificate](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/adobe-graphic-designer) – Master professional Adobe workflows to build high-impact creative assets.  
  * [Graphic Design Specialization](https://www.coursera.org/specializations/graphic-design) – Deepen your mastery of composition, typography, and visual communication.

* **UI/UX & Web Design:**  
  * [Figma UI/UX Masterclass](https://www.udemy.com/courses/search/?src=ukw&q=Figma%20UI%2FUX%20Masterclass) – Level up your Figma workflow to build scalable, interactive web and mobile prototypes.  
  * [UI/UX Designer Professional Certificate](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/ibm-ui-ux-designer) – Enhance your design portfolio with industry-standard UX/UI methodologies.

* **Art Foundations:**  
  * [Introduction to Drawing: Space and Composition](https://www.coursera.org/learn/introduction-to-drawing-space-and-composition) – Strengthen your core artistic foundations in composition and proportion.

Keep building your portfolio and polishing your digital designs—your creative skillset has tremendous long-term growth potential!
